authority: read-only current-host receipt, walker source, inventory source, and canonical ledger inspection

findings.summary: The control denominator is hand-assembled and not reconciled to one current-source manifest with selectors, handlers, effects, symbols, and hashes.
Action discovery scans only literal dashboard data-action values and does not prove outbound, host-handler, backend, acknowledgement, persistence, or failure contracts.
The runtime resolver supports action/command only; 523 records have no runtime selector and repeated control instances become ambiguous.
Authority classification is inferred from control kind and label instead of the canonical effect contract, causing safe local/read controls to be skipped.
The walk attempts only dashboard open plus fourteen navigation controls; both builders and four modal surfaces are hardcoded skipped.
Per-control chain evidence is structurally empty: no later lifecycle stages, state digests, screenshots, observed effects, or computed complete chains.
Surface discovery is current-DOM-led rather than denominator-led, does not await typed ready contracts, and does not attach screenshots/errors/overflow to exact controls.
The empty disposable workspace cannot prove seeded project persistence, attached memory, revision reopen, runtime integration, or recovery; a fixture matrix is required.
Launcher completion is based on process exit despite zero complete chains and skipped builders, while host unresponsive/no-token diagnostics are absent from host_errors.
The current receipt is not reconciled per control into canonical typed observations; legacy gap dispositions therefore prove inventory only.

recommended_order: canonical current-source manifest and source/action/handler reconciliation
exact runtime selectors and repeated-instance identities
per-control reversible local/read walker including builders
claim_boundary: This report proves gaps only. Process completion is not operational completeness, and no certification or closure is claimed.
